core_obligations: Comparison of the functors (proof lines 7913-7919): although the morphisms of sites used in the two constructions may differ, in both cases the induced pullback is described by the same rule, so the two morphisms of sites and the associated morphisms of topoi agree.
proof_roadmap: Observe that the two constructions may use different morphisms of sites.
Compare the descriptions of the induced pullbacks.
Conclude that the morphisms of topoi agree under the identifications.
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the diagram of morphisms of topoi obtained from the localization construction for morphisms of topoi agrees, under the identifications of the localizing sheaves, with the diagram obtained for morphisms of sites (statement lines 7895-7910). The proof is short and complete: the author observes that the two constructions may use different morphisms of sites, but in both cases the induced pullback is described by the same rule, so the resulting morphisms of topoi agree (proof lines 7913-7919). The non-formal content is the comparison of the two descriptions. The claim is H1: a one-step argument; the closing 'Some details omitted' concerns routine bookkeeping and is preserved verbatim in the counted span.
